# Daily Dashboard V0.5.12

Fixes the left, right and bottom gaps when Dashboard is locked to a Windows display, including the Waveshare ultrawide screen. Locked mode now disables the borderless window shadow that reserved space around the content, and verifies that both the window and content fill the entire monitor in physical pixels. Unlocking restores the normal window shadow.

- Monitor identity, disconnect/reconnect recovery and saved settings are preserved.
- macOS keeps its existing window/fullscreen behaviour.
- The startup updater from V0.5.11 remains available; previously saved update choices are retained.

Install over the existing version. [Dedicated-display setup and recovery](https://github.com/BananaAficionado/DailyDashboard/blob/main/docs/dedicated-display.md).

## Verification

Regression checks cover shadow-sized gaps at 75–200% display scaling, negative monitor coordinates, shifted content and taskbar work-area sizing. Windows CI builds the installer and runs native tests. Physical Waveshare/GPU testing is still needed to confirm the result on the affected hardware.
